gloss: to suck up; to absorb; to pump up

forms.label: Past polite
forms.negative: {吸|す}い{上|あ}げませんでした

forms.label: ている past
forms.negative: {吸|す}い{上|あ}げていなかった

forms.label: ている past polite
forms.negative: {吸|す}い{上|あ}げていませんでした

definitions.gloss: to suck up; to absorb; to pump up; to draw up
definitions.explanation: To draw liquid or moisture upward through suction or absorption. Used for pumps, plants, sponges, and similar mechanisms.

definitions.gloss: to gather up; to collect from below; to exploit
definitions.explanation: To collect money, opinions, or resources from lower levels of an organization or from the general population. Can carry a negative nuance of exploitation.

examples.japanese: ポンプで{水|みず}を{吸|す}い{上|あ}げる。
{植物|しょくぶつ}は{根|ね}から{水分|すいぶん}を{吸|す}い{上|あ}げる。
examples.english: Plants absorb moisture through their roots.

examples.japanese: スポンジがこぼれた{水|みず}をすぐに{吸|す}い{上|あ}げた。
examples.english: The sponge quickly absorbed the spilled water.

examples.japanese: {現場|げんば}の{声|こえ}を{吸|す}い{上|あ}げる。
examples.english: To gather feedback from the front lines.

examples.japanese: {市民|しみん}の{意見|いけん}を{吸|す}い{上|あ}げて{政策|せいさく}に{反映|はんえい}させる。
examples.english: To gather citizens' opinions and reflect them in policy.

examples.japanese: {大企業|だいきぎょう}が{地方|ちほう}の{富|とみ}を{吸|す}い{上|あ}げているという{批判|ひはん}がある。
examples.english: There is criticism that large corporations are siphoning wealth from rural areas.

notes:
A compound verb from {吸|す}う (to suck, to inhale) + {上|あ}げる (to raise). The upward direction distinguishes it from simply {吸|す}う.

TRANSITIVITY:
Transitive. No standard intransitive counterpart; the passive {吸|す}い{上|あ}げられる is used for the intransitive sense.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {水|みず}を{吸|す}い{上|あ}げる — to suck up water
- {意見|いけん}を{吸|す}い{上|あ}げる — to gather opinions
- {富|とみ}を{吸|す}い{上|あ}げる — to siphon off wealth
- {地下水|ちかすい}を{吸|す}い{上|あ}げる — to pump up groundwater

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {吸収|きゅうしゅう}する — to absorb (more formal/scientific)
- {汲|く}み{上|あ}げる — to scoop up, to draw up (physical: water from a well; figurative: gathering opinions)
- {搾取|さくしゅ}する — to exploit (stronger negative connotation than sense 2)
